post.title: Gifting your kid a down payment? Here's the IRS paperwork
post.ig:
Gift your kid $50,000 for a house? Expect IRS paperwork.
In 2026 each parent can give each child $19,000 with no gift tax return. Two parents giving $25,000 each cover $38,000; the other $12,000 goes on Form 709.
Filing usually means no tax: it trims a $15 million per-person lifetime exemption (2026).
Lenders want a signed gift letter (no repayment expected) plus proof the money moved. A family loan below the IRS minimum rate (AFR) can create a gift.
About 1 in 5 first-time buyers got a gift or loan from family or friends (NAR 2025 Profile).
Sources: IRS (2026 inflation adjustments, gift tax FAQ), Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-4.3-04, NAR 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers.
News and education, not financial advice.
